raw: De Ketelaere C. 7.0 De Roon M. 46'

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' Patrick Cutrone (Como) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Luca Pairetto lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
90+2' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Como comes to nothing.

90+1' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Nico Paz (Como) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. Como will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
90+1' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Luca Pairetto shows a yellow card to Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) for a tough tackle.
90' Alieu Fadera (Como) serves up a nice cross, but Marco Carnesecchi punches the ball away.
89' Nico Paz (Como) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
88' Today's referee Luca Pairetto rightly decides to book Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) for his harsh tackle.
87' Luca Pairetto couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Andrea Belotti (Como) and blew his whistle. It's a free kick to Atalanta, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
84' A cross from Alieu Fadera (Como) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
81' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Atalanta due to a handball in the build-up play.
81' The Atalanta players halt their celebrations as referee Luca Pairetto makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.
80' Goal! Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:3.
78' Here is a change. Ademola Lookman is going off and Gian Piero Gasperini gives the last tactical orders to Rafael Toloi (Atalanta).
77' A goal, which was scored by Patrick Cutrone (Como), was disallowed due to offside.
76' Nico Paz (Como) sends a cross into the box, but Marco Carnesecchi comes off his line to gather the ball.
74' Substitution. Andrea Belotti (Como) on for Marc Oliver Kempf.
73' The linesman raises his flag. Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is adjudged offside.

72' Patrick Cutrone (Como) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Marco Carnesecchi makes a comfortable save.

70' 1 - 2 Marco Brescianini is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot into the bottom right corner to make the score 1:2.
69' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) has a goal ruled out for offside!
68' Cesc Fabregas decides to make a substitution. Gabriel Strefezza will be replaced by Patrick Cutrone (Como).
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Maxence Caqueret (Como) is coming onto the pitch as Maximo Perrone cannot continue after picking up an injury.
67' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle as Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. Como are awarded the free kick.
66' Fellipe Jack (Como) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
66' Ederson (Atalanta) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. Como are awarded a free kick.
65' Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
64' Half-chance! Gabriel Strefezza (Como) plays a pass into the box, but Marco Carnesecchi reacts well to snuff out the attack.
62' Good team movement sets up Nico Paz (Como) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
59' Atalanta take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
59' Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball goes out of play. Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.
56' 1 - 1 Goal - 1:1! Marco Brescianini laid the ball off to Mateo Retegui (Atalanta), who shot from close range into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
56' Gian Piero Gasperini prepares a substitution. Giorgio Scalvini is replaced by Marco Brescianini (Atalanta).
55' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) comes onto the pitch so that Juan Cuadrado can be given a rest.
51' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) sees a yellow card from Luca Pairetto after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
51' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
50' A player from Atalanta commits a rough challenge. Luca Pairetto blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Free kick. Como will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
48' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) sends in a shot from a promising distance after a precise pass. His effort goes inches over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
47' The ball goes out of play. Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.
46' Half-time substitution. Gian Piero Gasperini decided to make a change. Marten de Roon (Atalanta) is replaced by Charles De Ketelaere.
46' Half-time substitution. Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) is replaced by Raoul Bellanova.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' Luca Pairetto has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Luca Pairetto interrupts the game. One of the players from Como won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Atalanta get a free kick.
45+2' Maximo Perrone (Como) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Looks like Maximo Perrone (Como) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

44' Alberto Dossena (Como) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
43' Luca Pairetto interrupts the game. One of the players from Como won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. A free kick has been awarded to Atalanta.
42' Referee Luca Pairetto sees the trip by Gabriel Strefezza (Como) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Atalanta have been awarded a free kick.
41' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle after Alberto Dossena (Como) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
40' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
40' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) produces a shot from a mid-range free kick. His effort is directed under the crossbar but is caught by the goalkeeper. Como will take a corner kick.
39' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for a foul. Como have a free kick.
38' Jean Butez leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Marten de Roon (Atalanta).
38' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. It will be a corner kick for Atalanta.
38' Maximo Perrone (Como) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Luca Pairetto saw the whole situation. Atalanta win a free kick.

37' A clever short pass gives Nico Paz (Como) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
35' Como concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
34' A player from Como commits a rough challenge. Luca Pairetto blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Atalanta will take a free kick near the side line.
31' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Como players have a reason to celebrate!
31' Como score a goal, but referee Luca Pairetto has now indicated he wants to check if the goal can stand using VAR!
30' 1 - 0 Goal! Alieu Fadera produces a great pass that finds Nico Paz (Como) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the top left corner. 1:0.
30' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Nico Paz (Como) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
30' Alieu Fadera (Como) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
30' The Como players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
26' Alberto Moreno is substituted due to injury. Cesc Fabregas gives a chance to Fellipe Jack (Como).
24' Alberto Moreno (Como) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
23' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
21' Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) commits a rough challenge and Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Como in a dangerous position.

19' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
19' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Atalanta is cautioned for aggressive play. It's a free kick to Como, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
18' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) sends a chip pass into the box, but Jean Butez is quickest to intercept the ball.
17' Alieu Fadera (Como) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.

14' What a save from Marco Carnesecchi! Yannik Engelhardt (Como) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
13' Como quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

13' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Alberto Moreno (Como) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender. Como force a corner. They send men into the box.
11' Alieu Fadera (Como) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marco Carnesecchi, who smothers the ball.
8' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Atalanta was in an offside position.
7' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

7' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Atalanta force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
6' Assane Diao (Como) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
5' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) makes a rough challenge and Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for a foul. Como are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
4' Nico Paz (Como) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Marco Carnesecchi, who pulls off a comfortable save!
3' A cross into the box from Assane Diao (Como) is cleared.
3' Nico Paz (Como) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
3' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jean Butez intercepts the ball.
3' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Atalanta will have the kick-off.
Luca Pairetto is the one to supervise the game today.
